name: Archie O'Loggins and the Enchanted Masks

features.name: Ability wilds
features.description: Each wild has its own power.

review:
Archie O'Loggins and the Enchanted Masks is a 7x7 cluster-pays jungle adventure with cascading avalanches. Different wilds have their own abilities, and the Wild Field feature transforms the reels.

Thunderkick rates it Very High volatility, with a 10,000x cap. The published RTP is 94.16%, on the low side.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
